import RNA, random, math, sys

target='...((((..(((((.....)))))..(((((...)))))..(((((.....)))))..(((((...)))))..(((((.....)))))..(((((.....))))).((((((((((((((((((((((((((((......))))).(((((.............((((.........................................)))).............)))))(((((....))))).)))))))))))))))))))))))..(((((.....)))))..(((((.....)))))..(((((.....)))))..(((((.....)))))..(((((....)))))..(((((.....))))).))))...'
n=len(target)
stack=[]; pair=[-1]*n
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pair[i]=j; pair[j]=i

def fold(s):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe(); return ss,mfe

def bpset(ss):
    st=[]; bps=set()
    for i,c in enumerate(ss):
        if c=='(': st.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=st.pop(); bps.add((min(i,j),max(i,j)))
    return bps
tbp=bpset(target)

def dist_and_diff(s):
    ss,_=fold(s)
    d=RNA.bp_distance(ss,target)
    sbs=bpset(ss)
    missing=tbs-sbs if False else tbp-sbs
    spurious=sbs-tbp
    return d,missing,spurious

# init: GC for pairs, A for unpaired (weak)
def init_seq():
    s=['A']*n
    for i in range(n):
        if pair[i]!=-1 and i<pair[i]:
            s[i]='G'; s[pair[i]]='C'
    return ''.join(s)

random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1)
cur=init_seq()
curd,_,_=dist_and_diff(cur)
best=cur; bestd=curd
T=3.0
import time
t0=time.time()
for it in range(100000):
    c=list(cur)
    i=random.randint(0,n-1)
    if pair[i]==-1:
        c[i]=random.choice(['A','U'])
    else:
        j=pair[i]
        a,b=random.choice([('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A'),('G','U'),('U','G')])
        c[i]=a; c[j]=b
    new=''.join(c)
    nd,_,_=dist_and_diff(new)
    if nd<=curd or random.random()<math.exp((curd-nd)/max(T,0.01)):
        cur=new; curd=nd
        if nd<bestd:
            best=new; bestd=nd
            print('it',it,'bestd',bestd,'t',round(time.time()-t0,1), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
            if bestd==0: break
    T*=0.9997
    if time.time()-t0>150: break
print('FINAL bestd',bestd, flush=True)
print(best, flush=True)
